findings.mechanism: The later-resolving initial response overwrites the rendered list with its own empty payload.
findings.statement: The filter response is applied before the initial response resolves in all four failing runs, and in none of the six passing runs.

openQuestions.howToAnswer: Run the same sequence with the initial response artificially delayed, and compare outcome rates.
openQuestions.question: Does delaying the initial response deterministically produce the failure?
openQuestions.whyItMatters: Only a controlled experiment can raise this above correlated; observation alone cannot establish direction.

notReproducedBy: Clicking the filter after the list has fully rendered: six runs did this and all passed.
preconditions: A cold browser context, so the initial request is not served from cache.

steps.action: Click the Verified filter before the initial list has finished loading

reproductionSteps.whyThisReproduces: The defect appears only when the filter request is issued while the initial request is still in flight, which is what step 2's timing forces.

output.summary: Four of ten runs failed. Every failing run logged console fingerprint cf_c285c4e7 and issued the filter request before the initial request completed; no passing run did either.

why: Stops at correlated because nothing varied the ordering deliberately, states the mechanism, and marks the timing-sensitive step.

evidenceGaps: Console capture was missing for RUN-003, RUN-005 and RUN-006, so the absence of console errors in those runs means nothing.

openQuestions.howToAnswer: Run a known-good control sequence against the same target.
openQuestions.question: Does the sequence ever pass?
openQuestions.whyItMatters: With no passing run, nothing in the contrast discriminates: any shared signal may simply be a property of the experiment.

steps.action: Follow the approved sequence; it failed on every attempt.

reproductionSteps.whyThisReproduces: The sequence failed eight times out of eight, so it reproduces reliably. Why it fails is not established.

output.summary: All eight runs failed, so there is no passing run to contrast against. Console capture was missing for three of them.

why: Refuses to find anything when every run failed, names why the contrast is uninformative, and does not read absence of console errors as absence of errors.
